result.summary: Makes LevelDB point-read and typed deserialization failures fatal inside CDBWrapper, logging the database path and notifying through the database owner's kernel notifications interface before aborting. txindex consistency errors and block-file read failures during transaction lookups are also routed through fatal error handling before aborting. In addition, the PR eliminates CCoinsViewErrorCatcher, connects CCoinsViewCache directly to CCoinsViewDB, restricts HaveCoin() to the cache view, and marks coin-view lookups noexcept.
result.problem: CDBWrapper::Read() returns false on deserialization failures (masking data corruption as missing keys) and propagates LevelDB point-read exceptions up the stack, allowing damaged txindex reads to fail an individual RPC request while the node continues running with corrupted storage. Chainstate also retains CCoinsViewErrorCatcher as a redundant view layer solely to intercept read errors and trigger shutdowns.
evidence: PR description: '#34931 made unreadable coin entries fatal, but CDBWrapper::Read() still returns false for deserialization failures and propagates LevelDB point-read exceptions to callers. A corrupt txindex point read can consequently fail one RPC while the node continues running.'

Release notes: 'LevelDB read errors and deserialization errors when looking up an entry in the chainstate, block index or optional index databases now abort the node after logging the database path and the error. Previously, such errors could surface as an initialization error during startup, as an RPC or REST error while the node kept running, or be mistaken for a missing entry.'
result.scope_notes: Refactors read and error-handling paths across CDBWrapper, CCoinsView, and indexes, deleting CCoinsViewErrorCatcher and TryRead while making coin-view lookups noexcept.
result.card: Makes LevelDB point-read and typed deserialization failures fatal inside CDBWrapper by logging the error, notifying kernel notifications, and aborting. It also makes txindex consistency and block-file read failures fatal, eliminates the CCoinsViewErrorCatcher view layer, restricts HaveCoin() to CCoinsViewCache, and marks coin-view lookups noexcept. Previously, corrupt index reads or block-file read errors could fail single RPC queries while leaving a damaged node running, or mask corrupt entries as absent keys.

risk.why: Mistakes in database read failure handling or unexpected exceptions escaping newly noexcept coin lookups could crash the node or cause false-positive aborts during block and transaction validation.
